multi_intent.question: What are the B.Tech CSE eligibility criteria, annual intake, and admission steps at SRGI?
sources: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) Programmes — Comprehensive Overview
SRGI Career Pathfinder and Course Selection Simulator
multi_intent.answer: **B.Tech CSE Eligibility Criteria:** - Minimum Qualifying Marks: At least 45% aggregate marks (40% for candidates belonging to SC/ST reserved categories). - Mandatory Subjects: Physics and Mathematics. - Recognized Optional Subjects: Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or Technical Vocational subject. **B.Tech CSE Annual Intake:** - Total Annual Intake: 180 seats. - Specialized Tracks: AI & ML (60 seats), AI (60 seats), DS (60 seats). **B.Tech CSE Admission Steps:** 1. **Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC / JEE Main score)**: Candidates can apply through this mode. 2. **Direct Institutional Merit Quota**: Candidates can also apply based on their merit in the direct quota, conforming to AKTU and state government norms. For more detailed information, you can refer to the official sources and provenance of S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI). Official sources include the SRGI Career Pathfinder and Course Selection Simulator, and the SRGI Career Enquiry and Eligibility page. Official sources and provenance: S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI), Lucknow (srgi_lucknow). Canonical Website: [srgi_lucknow](https://srgi_lucknow).

multi_intent.question: Tell me about the hostel facilities and dining arrangements, and explain the transport options available to students.
sources: Hostel Accommodation and Residential Life (2,000+ Capacity)
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) — Admissions, Academics and Life at SRGI
SRGI Lucknow Institutional Overview, Campus Profile and History
multi_intent.answer: The hostel facilities at SRGI Lucknow include separate wings for boys and girls, with amenities such as hygienic dining mess, fitness gym, high-speed Wi-Fi, power backup, and sports facilities. Students have 24-hour security and round-the-clock supervision. Dining arrangements offer a diverse menu of vegetarian and continental options, served in a spacious, well-ventilated setting. Students can avail of campus-operated transit services, including buses and vehicles, for commuting to and from the campus.

multi_intent.question: Which faculties and departments are offered, and what research areas are documented?
sources: Message from the Vice-Chairperson — Dr. Sushmita Singh
Faculty of Medical & Allied Health Sciences — Overview
Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) Programmes — Comprehensive Overview
multi_intent.answer: S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI), Lucknow offers four core academic faculties: Faculty of Engineering & Technology, Faculty of Management Studies, Faculty of Medical & Allied Health Sciences, and Faculty of Skill & Vocational Studies. The research areas documented include curricular rigor, industry readiness, and fostering faculty-student research publications and technical project development in the context of the Faculty of Management Studies, Faculty of Engineering & Technology, and Faculty of Medical & Allied Health Sciences. For the Faculty of Skill & Vocational Studies, the focus is on the B.Voc in Software Development programme.
